topic: Microscope Parts, Functions, and Proper Handling
key_concepts: Microscopy uses microscopes to view objects not seen by the unaided eye.
A microscope enlarges images of small objects.
The microscope has mechanical, magnifying, and illuminating parts.
Mechanical parts include the base, arm, stage, body tube, adjustment knobs, revolving nose
Magnifying parts are the objective lenses and eyepiece or ocular.
Illuminating parts include the mirror and condensing lens.
Carry a microscope by the base and metal support arm, not by the stage.
Do not let the objective lens touch the slide and clean lenses only with lens paper or wip
Cover the microscope when not in use and store it in a clean, dry place away from corrosiv
Turn off the illuminator and let the bulb cool before storing the microscope.
Service the microscope every 200 hours of use or every 3 years.
Under the microscope, the letter e appears inverted and enlarged.
